title: Habanero Mexican Cashews Tacos
description: Salty, spicy cashew tacos with a dairy‑free cheese pull, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and spread cashews on a baking sheet.
Roast cashews for 10 minutes or until golden and fragrant, stirring halfway.
While cashews roast, mix habanero slices, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and half the cilantro in a bowl.
Once cashews are done, let them cool slightly before adding to the habanero mixture; stir until cashews are evenly coated.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side.
Spoon the spicy cashew mixture onto each tortilla, leaving room for topping.
Sprinkle shredded vegan cheese over the cashew layer so it melts slightly.
Finish by garnishing with remaining cilantro and a squeeze of lime; serve with lime wedges on the side.
